tool_args.rationale: The verified bridge points to a two-layer siphon, but the pilot samples only one input dimension at a single horizon. A discriminating probe is needed before fitting and forecasting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a two-layer siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now, leaving the coupled dynamics and dependence on the other inputs unidentified.
The cheaper open-branch probe is better targeted to the current mechanism ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
